<issue>
[sm6.10] coopvec input vec type convert
**Description**
There is a simple convert from f16 to fp8 for input vec, however, the dxil looks incorrect.
hlsl:
typedef vector<half, 16> half16;
half16 srcF16 = inbuf.Load<half16>(0);
InterpretedVector<uint, 4, ComponentEnum::F8_E4M3FN> converted =
      Convert<ComponentEnum::F8_E4M3FN, ComponentEnum::F16>(srcF16);

dxil:
  %4 = call %dx.types.ResRet.v16f16 @dx.op.rawBufferVectorLoad.v16f16(i32 303, %dx.types.Handle %3, i32 0, i32 undef, i32 2)  ; RawBufferVectorLoad(buf,index,elementOffset,alignment)
  %5 = extractvalue %dx.types.ResRet.v16f16 %4, 0
  %6 = shufflevector <16 x half> %5, <16 x half> undef, <4 x i32> <i32 0, i32 1, i32 2, i32 3>
  %7 = call <4 x i32> @dx.op.linAlgConvert.v4i32.v4f16(i32 -2147483618, **<4 x half> %6**, i32 8, i32 21)  ; LinAlgConvert(**inputVector**,inputInterpretation,outputInterpretation)

we expected <16 x half> %5 as the convert input, but it shufflevector to <4xhalf> which is not expected.

Is there something wrong from this hlsl or dxc problem

**Steps to Reproduce**

**Actual Behavior**

**Environment**

- Host Operating System <!--- Host operating system and version --->


</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed (DXC), find where HLSL `Convert` builtin for coopvec/linalg (dx.op.linAlgConvert / LinAlgConvert) is lowered in tools/clang/lib/CodeGen (HLSLToDXIR / CGHLSLMS.cpp) and how the input vector's element count is computed (a shufflevector truncates a <16 x half> to <4 x half>, using the packed output vector size). Report the exact file, line numbers and code of the relevant lowering, plus the Sema/type definition of Convert in tools/clang/lib/Sema or utils/hct/gen_intrin_main.txt / HLOperationLower.cpp.

content.content: {"summary":"Convert is lowered in lib/HLSL/HLOperationLower.cpp (TranslateLinAlgConvert), not in CGHLSLMS.cpp. The input vector is passed straight to dx.op.linAlgConvert with no shufflevector. The output element count comes from DstN in linalg.h. Sema has no special handling. The premise that a shufflevector truncates <16 x half> to <4 x half> is not supported by the code I read.","findings":["lib/HLSL/HLOperationLower.cpp:7142-7159: TranslateLinAlgConvert takes OutVecTy from the out-pointer arg (CI->getArgOperand(1)), InVec from arg 2, InInterp from arg 3, OutInterp from arg 4. It calls GetOpFunc(LinAlgConvert, {OutVecTy, InVec->getType()}), emits CreateCall(DxilFunc, {OpArg, InVec, InInterp, OutInterp}), and stores the result to OutVecPtr. No CreateShuffleVector is used.","lib/HLSL/HLOperationLower.cpp:7958-7959: table entry maps IOP___builtin_LinAlg_Convert to TranslateLinAlgConvert with DXIL::OpCode::LinAlgConvert.","tools/clang/lib/Headers/hlsl/dx/linalg.h:188-192: DstN<DstTy,SrcTy,SrcN>::Value = (SrcN * ComponentTypeTraits<SrcTy>::ElementsPerScalar) / ComponentTypeTraits<DstTy>::ElementsPerScalar. This is the output element count, and it is packed-scalar aware.","tools/clang/lib/Headers/hlsl/dx/linalg.h:213-223: Convert<DestTy,OriginTy,T,N>(vector<T,N>) declares Result as vector<ComponentTypeTraits<DestTy>::Type, DstN<...>::Value>, calls __builtin_LinAlg_Convert(Result, Vec, OriginTy, DestTy), and wraps the result with MakeInterpretedVector<DestTy>.","utils/hct/gen_intrin_main.txt:412: builtin declaration void __builtin_LinAlg_Convert(out numeric<> ret, in numeric<> vec, in uint input_interp, in uint output_interp).","tools/clang/lib/CodeGen/CGHLSLMS.cpp:6021 and :6053 are the only CreateShuffleVector uses in this area. They handle scalar splat and matrix init, not Convert. CGHLSLMS.cpp has no LinAlgConvert lowering.","Sema: grep found no LinAlg_Convert handling under tools/clang/lib/Sema or tools/clang/lib/AST. Type checking comes from the builtin declaration and linalg.h.","include/dxc/DXIL/DxilConstants.h:556 and :1356 define the LinAlgConvert opcode. lib/DXIL/DxilOperations.cpp:2979-2982 gives the overload name 'linAlgConvert'. The output element count comes from the result vector type the caller provides, not from a shuffle."],"confidence":0.8}

input.instruction: In /testbed/utils/hct/gen_intrin_main.txt around line 412 look at __builtin_LinAlg_Convert and neighboring LinAlg builtins, and check how other builtins express differing vector sizes for args (e.g. "numeric<>" vs "numeric<>" vs "vector<...>"). In tools/clang/lib/Sema/SemaHLSL.cpp find how a LITEMPLATE/ArgType 'numeric<>' vec arg is matched for intrinsic overloads and how implicit conversion (vector truncation) could happen from vector<half,16> to vector<half,4> for the 'vec' param (the out param type probably gets used as the template type for all numeric<> args). Report what to change so the input vec keeps its own type.

content.content: {"summary":"The `vec` input is not pinned to its own vector size. `__builtin_LinAlg_Convert` declares both `ret` and `vec` as unsized `numeric<>`, and SemaHLSL matching tracks only the shape kind per template slot, so a size-16 input can match a size-4 slot. Nothing was built or run, so the truncation path is inferred from the code.","findings":["utils/hct/gen_intrin_main.txt:412: `__builtin_LinAlg_Convert(out numeric<> ret, in numeric<> vec, in uint input_interp, in uint output_interp)` leaves both vector arguments unsized.","utils/hct/gen_intrin_main.txt:407-408 use named placeholders `numeric<c>`/`numeric<c2>` to link sizes in MatrixVectorMultiply(Add). Convert has no equivalent link.","utils/hct/gen_intrin_main.txt:78-92 documents `$typeN` (copy argument N's type) as a way to tie an output to an input. A possible fix is `out $type1 ret`, but this is untested and would also copy the input component type to the output, which may be wrong when output_interp changes the type.","utils/hct/hctdb.py:~9700-9713 maps template ids -1/-3/-4 to INTRIN_TEMPLATE_FROM_TYPE / FROM_FUNCTION / FROM_FUNCTION_2, so an unsized `numeric<>` arg shares the single FROM_TYPE slot with every other such arg.","tools/clang/lib/Sema/SemaHLSL.cpp:~7040-7050 records only the shape kind (scalar/vector/matrix) per template slot and explicitly allows vector truncation, so the component count is not checked.","tools/clang/lib/Sema/SemaHLSL.cpp:~7171-7200: an unsized FROM_TYPE arg (rows==0, cols==0) gets `pNewType = objectElement`, the matched overload's element type, so `ret` and `vec` are not constrained to the same size."],"confidence":0.5}
